mechanics.claim: At 2 Echo stacks, the next basic ability cast consumes them to cast an additional time at no cost.
mechanics.quote: At 2 stacks, the next basic ability cast consumes them all to cast an additional time at no cost after a {{rutngt|0.01}} delay.

mechanics.claim: The additional Echo cast counts as a separate cast instance (e.g. for Electrocute/Conqueror), and does not affect the mimicked ability's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: The additional cast does not affect the {{sti|cooldown}} of the mimicked ability.

mechanics.claim: The additional cast must complete or Echo stacks are retained (not consumed).
mechanics.quote: if the cast time does not finish, does not begin at all, or if the ability fails to cast, '''Seraphine''' will keep her stacks.

mechanics.claim: While any Notes are active, Seraphine's next basic attack is empowered with an uncancellable windup and fires all Notes at the target as separate magic damage instances.
mechanics.quote: '''Seraphine's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} per ''Note'', and fire all ''Notes'' at the target

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack can critically strike.
Ability casts grant Notes to Seraphine and nearby allied champions.
mechanics.quote: '''Seraphine's''' ability casts grant a ''Note'' to herself and nearby allied {{tip|champions}}
